_meta.name: Sereno — Known-Bad npm Packages
_meta.description: Compromised npm package scopes and specific versions. A scope entry means some packages under it had compromised releases: Sereno reports those packages as medium and asks you to compare versions. Packages maps a full name (scoped or not) to its known-bad versions: an exact match is critical, and other versions aren't reported; an empty list means the list doesn't say which versions are bad, so a match is medium, asking you to check your version.
